patterns.note: All page content is contained within a single, large, rounded-corner card that is horizontally and vertically centered on the screen.
High contrast is used between a dark, gradient background and a stark white content card to make the text highly legible and the card stand out as the primary focus.
A playful, bold display font is used for the main title 'WHYLABS', contrasting with a clean, standard sans-serif for the extensive body text.
The page exhibits no scroll-triggered motion; content within the central card scrolls naturally, but no elements reveal, animate, parallax, or stick beyond standard browser behavior.

technique_notes: The page uses a full-bleed, subtle gradient background that remains static. A single, large content card with rounded corners is positioned absolutely to be horizontally and vertically centered on the viewport. The content within this card is scrollable if it overflows, utilizing the browser's default scroll behavior without any custom scroll-triggered animations or reveals.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold, uppercase display heading (~2.5x body) with standard body text and slightly bolder sub-headings.
design_tokens.radius: rounded for the main content card, with no other elements exhibiting significant corner radius.
design_tokens.spacing: airy overall due to the large amount of negative space around the central content card; balanced padding within the card.

standout: The site's design is distinctive in its extreme minimalism, presenting a single, self-contained announcement within a prominent, rounded card. It feels less like a typical website and more like a digital letter or official statement, prioritizing the message's clarity and directness above all else.
